note: v1 92.46 (seeds 0/11 92.46/92.33), first draft of EUPHORIC ANTHEM, 'Ring Road Sunrise': piano-led liquid D&B, the night's last tune as the sky goes pale. A concert grand plays house-piano stabs on Dmaj9 - E6 - C#m7 - F#m9 in the drops and holds each chord, rolled, outside them; a soaring wordless voice line into a long hall, strings doubling it in the second drop; a straight amen roll with a crash on every phrase, a sub and a low reese pumped by it. The break ends on wM's endless Shepard rise under a snare roll - a climb that never seems to arrive until the last drop lands. v2 96.19 (seeds 0/11 96.19/96.16 vs v1 rebaselined 95.54/95.47): THE LIFT and THE CHEST. An anthem needs its key change: the last sixteen bars of the second drop and the outro now go up a semitone, A major to Bb major - piano, strings, the soaring voice, sub and reese all together - so the final run lifts once more just when it should be ending. And it gets a chest: a machine-kit kick under the amen's own kicks (the one and the and-of-3), and the piano's drop stabs gain the left hand's octave on the root, filling the thin low-mids under the roll (spectrum 78 -> 83). Levels stay on the standard: -12.8 LUFS, true peak -1.36 dBTP, run 1; true_peak on.
